summary: Both editions were independently checked against every clause of the supplied Greek working source. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the negations, speaker changes, punishment imagery, life-and-death assertions, saving pleasures, and the condition of persisting without repentance. “Servants” and contextual “repent” follow current policy. The two bracketed [φησί,] speech tags are editorial supplements in the supplied source; their omission does not remove preserved content or obscure attribution. The repentance notes do not impose an additional doctrinal condition. Acceptance is limited to fidelity to the supplied working source and accompanying disclosures, not authentication of unseen editions or manuscripts, exhaustive collation, or certification of a unique interpretation.
